title: §.XII open: MEMBRUM SECUNDUM — Theologi & Socii promiscuè; first distinguish late vs strict appellandi
pass_a_gloss: §. XII. Thus far we have dispatched the FIRST MEMBER of our first Annotation, concerning the Nature of the Augsburg Confession itself; it follows that, carried over to the SECOND MEMBER, we treat briefly, according to the plan of our undertaking, of the Theologians and Associates of that same Confession promiscuously. Where first of all we judge a distinction must be made between those so called Loosely and Strictly.
pass_b_english: §. XII. So far we have finished the first member of this first Annotation — the nature of the Augsburg Confession itself.
Next, under the second member, we treat briefly, as our plan requires, of that Confession's theologians and associates in the broad sense.
First we distinguish those so called loosely from those so called strictly.
source_text:
§. XII.
Adhuc Annotationis nostrae primae MEMBRUM PRIMUM expedivimus, ipsius Augustanae Confessionis Naturam concernens; sequitur, ut ad MEMBRUM SECUNDUM delati, de Confessionis ejusdem Theologis & Sociis promiscuè, pro instituti nostri ratione, paucis agamus. Ubi omnium primò distinguendum arbitramur, inter Latè & Strictè sic appellandos.
